name: Ansible
certifications: Red Hat Certified Specialist in Developing Automation with Ansible Automation Platform (EX374)

beginner.summary: No automation experience assumed. Participants automate Linux servers with inventories, ad hoc commands, playbooks, templates, handlers, roles and Vault.
prerequisites: Comfortable with SSH and a text editor
Laptop able to run three small Linux VMs or containers
outcomes: Write idempotent playbooks with templates and handlers
Organise automation into roles and inventories

days.topic: Configuration Management Concepts and Ansible Setup
subtopics: Ansible architecture: control node and managed nodes
Installing Ansible with pip or packages
SSH key access to managed nodes
Testing connectivity with the ping module
days.lab_task: Install Ansible on a control node, set up SSH key access to three managed nodes, write an inventory with web and db groups, and ping all of them.
days.deliverable: ansible.cfg, inventory file and the ping output
checks: Participant explains running twice gives the same result

days.topic: Ad Hoc Commands and Core Modules
days.lab_task: Use ad hoc commands to install nginx on web nodes, create a deploy user on all nodes, copy a file and restart a service, then gather facts about memory and OS.
days.deliverable: Command log and fact output
checks: Check the deploy user on each node

days.lab_task: Write a playbook that installs and starts nginx, deploys a custom index page and opens the firewall port, then run it in check mode, normally, and a second time.
days.deliverable: Playbook, three run outputs and a clean lint result
checks: Run the playbook a second time
Open each web node in a browser

days.topic: Inventory Groups, Host Settings and Group Settings
days.lab_task: Restructure the inventory into dev and prod with group_vars for each, set a different page title per environment, and target only prod web servers.
days.deliverable: Inventory folders and outputs for both environments
checks: Dev page shows the dev title
objectives: Store settings in group_vars and host_vars

days.lab_task: Write one playbook that installs the right web server package for Debian and Red Hat nodes, checks disk space before installing, and fails with a clear message if space is low.
days.deliverable: Playbook and runs on both OS families
checks: Run on a Debian and a Red Hat node
Play fails with the clear message
Register a command result and print it

days.topic: Loops and Data Structures in Playbooks
days.lab_task: Create ten users with groups and SSH keys from a list in group_vars, create their home folders with set permissions, and retry a flaky download with until.
days.deliverable: Playbook, data file and run output
checks: Add one user to the list and rerun
Simulate a failing download that succeeds on retry

days.lab_task: Generate an nginx site configuration from a template with a loop over upstream servers and a conditional TLS block, validating the file before replacing it.
days.deliverable: Template, playbook and the generated configuration
checks: Add an upstream server in group_vars
Introduce a syntax error in the template
Validation stops the bad file being deployed
Turn TLS on for prod only
Only prod files contain the TLS block
objectives: Use conditions and loops in Jinja2

subtopics: Debugging handlers that do not run
days.lab_task: Make nginx reload only when its configuration changes, using handlers, and show that a run with no changes does not restart the service.
days.deliverable: Playbook and run outputs with and without changes
checks: Not restarted on the no-change run
objectives: Trigger service actions only on change

days.lab_task: Refactor the web server playbook into an nginx role and a users role with defaults, use both from a site playbook, and reuse the nginx role with different settings.
days.deliverable: Role folders, site playbook and runs
checks: Same result as before the refactor
Override a role default in group_vars
Lists defaults and how to use the role

days.lab_task: Install the community.general and ansible.posix collections and a community role from requirements.yml with pinned versions, and use them in a playbook with fully qualified names.
days.deliverable: requirements.yml, playbook and install output
checks: Install requirements on a fresh control node
Explains why the community role was trusted

days.lab_task: Store the database password in an encrypted file, use it in a template, hide it from output with no_log, and rotate the vault password.
days.deliverable: Encrypted file, playbook and run output
checks: Open the vault file without the password
Password does not appear in output
Playbook works with the new password only

days.topic: Managing Files, Packages and Services at Scale
subtopics: Firewall rules with firewalld or ufw
days.lab_task: Build a baseline role that sets timezone and NTP, hardens SSH, configures the firewall, installs a monitoring agent from its repository and reboots only when the kernel changes.
days.deliverable: Baseline role and runs on all nodes
checks: Password login and root login are disabled
Run when no kernel update exists

subtopics: Removing nodes from the load balancer
days.lab_task: Deploy a web application to four servers one at a time behind a load balancer, with health checks after each server and an automatic stop if one fails.
days.deliverable: Deploy playbook and run outputs for a good and a bad release
checks: Stops after the first server and that server is restored
objectives: Stop and roll back on failure

subtopics: ignore_errors and when to avoid it
days.lab_task: Fix five broken playbooks prepared by the trainer, then wrap a risky change in block and rescue so it rolls back automatically on failure.
days.deliverable: Fixed playbooks, troubleshooting log and the block-rescue playbook
checks: Force the risky change to fail
objectives: Handle errors with block and rescue

days.lab_task: Add Molecule tests to the nginx role that converge it on two OS images, check idempotence and verify the site responds.
days.deliverable: Molecule configuration, tests and a passing run

days.lab_task: Configure a dynamic inventory that finds cloud servers by tag, groups them by environment and role, and runs the baseline role against new servers automatically.
days.deliverable: Inventory plugin configuration and runs before and after adding a server
checks: It appears in the right group without editing files

days.lab_task: Connect to a Windows server, install IIS, deploy a site, set a registry value and install updates in a maintenance playbook.
days.deliverable: Inventory settings, playbook and run output

days.lab_task: Back up configuration from two virtual routers, apply VLAN and interface settings with resource modules, and show check mode reporting the differences first.
days.deliverable: Backup files, playbook and check mode output
checks: Shows the planned changes without applying

subtopics: Linting and syntax checks in CI
days.lab_task: Create a pipeline that lints and tests roles on pull requests, applies playbooks to dev on merge, and runs prod only after approval, with a nightly check-mode drift report.
days.deliverable: Pipeline configuration and runs for each stage
checks: Open a pull request with a lint error
Nightly check mode reports the drift

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Automated Web Platform with Ansible
days.lab_task: Automate a web platform with load balancer, two web servers and a database across dev and prod using roles, Vault, rolling deploys, Molecule tests and a pipeline, then rebuild a server during the demo.
days.deliverable: Automation repository, pipeline runs and a 10-minute demo
checks: Rebuild a web server from scratch
Back in service after one playbook run
Search the repository for plain secrets
objectives: Combine roles, secrets, deploys and tests

intermediate.summary: For people who write Ansible roles. Covers advanced playbook design, collection development, execution environments, Ansible Automation Platform, event-driven automation, security and scale.
prerequisites: Writes roles and playbooks with templates, handlers and Vault
Comfortable with Linux administration and Git
Has run Ansible against more than a few servers
outcomes: Design maintainable automation for large estates
Build and test collections and execution environments
Run automation through Ansible Automation Platform with RBAC
Use event-driven automation and integrate with other tools

days.topic: Advanced Playbook Design and Precedence Rules
days.lab_task: Debug a provided project where settings come from six places, document the precedence that applies, and redesign it to use as few sources as possible.
days.deliverable: Precedence analysis and the redesigned project
checks: Fewer sources with the same results
Use delegate_to for a load balancer task
Runs on the load balancer only

days.lab_task: Write a module that manages entries in an internal REST API idempotently with check mode, a filter plugin for formatting, and unit tests for both.
days.deliverable: Module, filter plugin, tests and documentation
checks: Reports the change without making it
objectives: Extend Ansible with modules and plugins

subtopics: Publishing to Automation Hub or Galaxy
days.lab_task: Package the roles and module into a versioned collection, pass ansible-test sanity, publish it to a private hub, and install it in another project.
days.deliverable: Collection source, build artefact and install evidence
checks: Install the collection by version elsewhere

subtopics: Running playbooks in an execution environment
days.lab_task: Build an execution environment with the project's collections and Python dependencies, run the site playbook inside it with ansible-navigator, and scan the image.
days.deliverable: Definition file, built image and run output
checks: Same results as on the control node
Run on a machine without the collections installed
Works because they are in the image
No critical vulnerabilities or each is explained

days.topic: Ansible Automation Platform: Controller Projects, Inventories and Job Templates
days.lab_task: Set up projects, a dynamic inventory source, credentials and job templates with surveys in the automation controller, and give a support team permission to run only the restart template.
days.deliverable: Controller configuration and job history
checks: Support user launches the restart template

days.topic: Workflows and Approvals in Automation Controller
days.lab_task: Build a workflow that provisions a server, applies the baseline, deploys the app, waits for approval, then runs the prod step, with a failure path that notifies and rolls back.
days.deliverable: Workflow definition and runs for success and failure
checks: Pauses at approval and continues after approval
Read job output passed between steps
Data used by the next job

days.topic: Configuration as Code for the Automation Platform
days.lab_task: Describe all controller projects, inventories, templates and RBAC in Git, apply them with a playbook, and rebuild the configuration on a fresh controller.
days.deliverable: Configuration repository and the rebuild evidence
checks: Next run restores the Git version

subtopics: Event sources: webhooks, Kafka, monitoring alerts
days.lab_task: Write a rulebook that receives an Alertmanager alert when nginx is down and runs a remediation job template, with throttling so repeated alerts do not run it repeatedly.
days.deliverable: Rulebook, alert configuration and remediation evidence
checks: Alert triggers the remediation job and nginx is back
Send the same alert five times in a minute

subtopics: CIS and STIG baselines with Ansible
days.lab_task: Scan servers against a CIS profile, apply remediation with Ansible, rescan to prove improvement, and read database credentials from HashiCorp Vault instead of Ansible Vault.
days.deliverable: Before and after scan reports, remediation playbook and Vault lookup
checks: Search the repository for the database password

days.topic: Performance and Scale for Large Inventories
days.lab_task: Cut the run time of the site playbook against 100 simulated hosts by at least 60% using forks, pipelining, fact caching and async tasks, measuring each change.
days.deliverable: Tuned configuration and a timing table
checks: Rerun with the fact cache warm
Same end state as before tuning

days.topic: Ansible with Terraform and Cloud Provisioning
subtopics: Dividing work between Terraform and Ansible
Immutable images with Packer and Ansible
days.lab_task: Provision servers with Terraform, build a golden image with Packer running Ansible roles, and configure the remaining settings with Ansible from Terraform outputs.
days.deliverable: Terraform, Packer and Ansible code with a full pipeline run
checks: Servers start from the golden image and pass health checks
Rebuild the image after a role change
No setting is managed by both tools
objectives: Build images with Packer and Ansible

subtopics: Managing containers with Podman and Docker modules
days.lab_task: Deploy an application to a local cluster with kubernetes.core and Helm modules, wait for the rollout, and build a small Ansible-based operator with Operator SDK.
days.deliverable: Playbooks, operator code and deployment evidence
checks: Waits until the rollout is ready

days.lab_task: Define a test strategy for the collection and add Molecule scenarios for upgrade paths, check-mode tests and integration tests in CI.
days.deliverable: Test strategy document, tests and CI run
checks: Role upgrades from the previous version cleanly

days.lab_task: Build a patching workflow that snapshots, drains, patches, reboots and checks each server in batches, holds excluded packages, and reports status.
days.deliverable: Patching workflow and status report
checks: Each server is drained, patched and returned to service
Server stays drained and the workflow stops
Lists patched, skipped and failed servers

days.topic: Integrating Ansible with ITSM and ChatOps
days.lab_task: Let users request a server restart from a chat command or a ticket, run it through an approved job template, and post the result back to the ticket and chat.
days.deliverable: Integration configuration and an end-to-end request record
checks: Job runs and the result is posted back
Ticket is updated with the job result
objectives: Expose automation through tickets and chat

subtopics: Inventory design for thousands of hosts
days.lab_task: Design inventory and content organisation for 5,000 hosts across 10 teams, build constructed inventories by role and environment, and set content ownership rules.
days.deliverable: Design document, constructed inventories and ownership rules
checks: Returns hosts by role and environment
Each collection has an owner and review rule

days.lab_task: Export job metrics, build a dashboard of success rate, failed hosts and time saved, and alert when a critical job fails twice in a row.
days.deliverable: Dashboard, alert rule and a time-saved report
checks: Based on stated manual time assumptions

days.topic: Automation Platform Operations: High Availability and Upgrades
days.lab_task: Add execution nodes and a hop node for a remote site, back up the platform, simulate a node failure and restore service within the target time.
days.deliverable: Mesh topology, backup record and recovery timeline
checks: Run a job at the remote site through the hop node
Job runs on the remote execution node
objectives: Reach remote sites with automation mesh
Back up and restore the platform

days.topic: Migrating Scripts and Legacy Automation to Ansible
days.lab_task: Convert three provided legacy shell scripts to idempotent roles, run old and new side by side on test servers, and prove the same end state.
days.deliverable: Converted roles, comparison results and a migration plan for the remaining scripts
checks: Compare server state after old and new runs
No changes on the second run

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Automation Platform for an Operations Team
subtopics: Controller configuration as code and RBAC
days.lab_task: Build an automation platform with a tested collection, an execution environment, controller configuration as code, workflows with approvals, event-driven remediation and dashboards, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repositories, platform configuration, dashboards and a 15-minute demo
checks: Remediation runs once and service recovers
Run the patching workflow with approval
objectives: Design an automation platform for a team

advanced.summary: For engineers who lead automation programmes. Covers automation architecture, platform engineering, self-healing infrastructure, governance, security, performance at extreme scale and automation strategy.
prerequisites: Has built collections and run Ansible Automation Platform or AWX
Comfortable with Python, CI/CD and cloud provisioning
RHCE level knowledge or equivalent experience
outcomes: Design enterprise automation architectures and operating models
Build self-healing and event-driven operations with safe guardrails
Govern and secure automation at scale
Lead automation strategy with measured business value

subtopics: Automation domains: infrastructure, network, security, cloud
Platform topology across regions and sites
days.lab_task: Design the automation architecture for a company with 20,000 servers, 3,000 network devices and four regions, and write decision records for topology, content and credentials.
days.deliverable: Architecture document and three decision records
checks: Explains controllers, execution nodes and hop nodes per region
Options, criteria and the reason for the choice
Participant explains least privilege and rotation at scale
objectives: Design automation architecture at enterprise scale

days.topic: Automation Operating Model and Centre of Excellence
subtopics: Roles: platform team, content owners, contributors
days.lab_task: Design an automation centre of excellence for a provided organisation with roles, contribution rules, content certification and adoption metrics, and pilot the contribution process.
days.deliverable: Operating model document and a piloted contribution

subtopics: Guardrails: rate limits, blast radius, approvals
days.lab_task: Build self-healing for three common incidents with event correlation, blast-radius limits and escalation, and show a remediation loop being stopped by the guardrails.
days.deliverable: Rulebooks, guardrail configuration and incident evidence
checks: Each is remediated or escalated as designed

days.topic: Automation Content Supply Chain and Signing
days.lab_task: Sign internal collections, require signature verification at install, curate an approved content list in the private hub, and run a tabletop for a compromised collection.
days.deliverable: Signing setup, verification evidence, approved list and tabletop notes
objectives: Secure the automation content supply chain

days.lab_task: Replace stored machine credentials with short-lived credentials issued by Vault per job, automate rotation for remaining secrets, and report credential use per job.
days.deliverable: Credential configuration, rotation automation and usage report
checks: Uses a credential issued for that job only
Reuse the credential after the job
Lists credentials per job and user

subtopics: Running against tens of thousands of hosts
Rate limits on targets and APIs
days.lab_task: Load test the platform with simulated hosts, find the first bottleneck, apply job slicing and capacity changes, and meet a target of patching 10,000 hosts in the window.
days.deliverable: Load test reports and a capacity plan
checks: First limit is identified with evidence
States nodes needed for stated growth

subtopics: Network source of truth with NetBox or Nautobot
days.lab_task: Drive device configuration from NetBox, validate changes with Batfish before applying, run pre and post checks, and roll back automatically on failure.
days.deliverable: Source-of-truth setup, change pipeline and runs for success and rollback
checks: Submit a change that breaks reachability
Batfish blocks it before devices change
objectives: Run network automation from a source of truth

days.lab_task: Automate containment for a simulated compromised host: isolate it at the firewall, collect evidence, open a ticket and notify the SOC, with approval required before destructive steps.
days.deliverable: Automation content, approval flow and incident timeline
checks: Host is isolated and evidence collected within target time
Attempt a destructive step without approval

days.topic: Governance, Risk and Compliance for Automation
subtopics: Policy as code for automation content
days.lab_task: Classify automation by risk, enforce approvals by tier, check content with policy as code before release, and produce an audit report for a quarter.
days.deliverable: Risk classification, policies, approval configuration and audit report
checks: Run a high-risk job without approval
Release content that breaks a policy

days.topic: Automation for Hybrid Cloud and Edge Sites
days.lab_task: Automate 20 simulated edge sites with hop nodes and pull-based runs, roll a change out in waves, and show a disconnected site catching up.
days.deliverable: Edge architecture, rollout record and catch-up evidence
checks: Second wave starts only after the first succeeds
Site applies the change after reconnecting
Covers credentials and updates at remote sites

days.topic: Advanced Testing and Quality Engineering for Automation
subtopics: Testing at scale with ephemeral environments
days.lab_task: Build a certification pipeline for collections with regression, contract and chaos tests in ephemeral environments, and measure defect escape rate over sample releases.
days.deliverable: Pipeline, test suites and quality report
checks: Release a collection with a regression
Automation handles target failures as designed

days.lab_task: Build programme dashboards for reliability, time saved and adoption, analyse the top 10 failure causes across sample job data, and create an improvement backlog.
days.deliverable: Dashboards, failure analysis and improvement backlog
checks: Top causes with counts and examples
Each item targets a failure cause with a metric

days.lab_task: Generate three roles with an AI assistant, review and test them to the certification standard, and record defects found and time saved.
days.deliverable: Reviewed roles, defect log and productivity measurements
checks: Run certification tests on the reviewed roles
Time saved compared with manual authoring
objectives: Use AI to speed up automation authoring

days.topic: Migrating Between Automation Platforms and Tools
subtopics: Migrating from AWX to Ansible Automation Platform
Migrating from Puppet, Chef or Salt
days.lab_task: Plan and pilot a migration from a Puppet-managed estate to Ansible: convert two modules, run both tools in parallel on test nodes, prove parity, and write the cut-over plan.
days.deliverable: Converted content, parity results and cut-over plan
checks: Compare node state from both tools
No changes on the second run

days.topic: Automation Business Case and Value Realisation
days.lab_task: Build a business case for automating five operational processes with effort, error and outage data, then track realised value for the first two after a simulated quarter.
days.deliverable: Business case and value tracking report
checks: Each process has cost, benefit and payback
Realised value compared with the estimate

days.topic: Platform Engineering with Ansible and Self-Service Portals
days.lab_task: Expose three automation products through a Backstage self-service catalogue that calls the automation controller, shows request status, and enforces guardrails.
days.deliverable: Catalogue integration, three products and request records
checks: Job runs and status updates in the portal
Time to fulfil requests is measured

days.lab_task: Diagnose and fix seven hard platform failures injected by the trainer, including a broken mesh link, a slow database and a failing credential lookup.
days.deliverable: Diagnosis log with symptom, evidence, root cause and fix for each
checks: Jobs run at the remote site again
Job start times return to normal

subtopics: Reliability, security, scale and cost criteria
days.lab_task: Review another team's automation platform design, write two decision records for its biggest risks, and present recommendations with evidence.
days.deliverable: Review report, two decision records and a 10-minute presentation
checks: Each high risk has evidence and a recommendation
Options, criteria and the reason for the choice
Defended with cost and risk evidence

days.lab_task: Assess a provided organisation's automation maturity, propose a three-year roadmap with investment priorities, and present it to a mock leadership panel.
days.deliverable: Maturity assessment, roadmap and presentation
checks: Each area has evidence and a level
Items have outcomes, owners and metrics
Budget and risk questions answered with evidence

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Enterprise Automation Platform and Programme
days.lab_task: Design and prototype an enterprise automation platform and programme covering architecture, content supply chain, credentials, self-healing, governance, value measurement and operating model, then defend it to a review board.
days.deliverable: Architecture document, working prototype, governance and resilience test evidence, value model and a 20-minute review presentation
checks: Run a high-risk automation through the prototype
Approved, executed with short-lived credentials and audited
Costs and benefits are stated with assumptions
objectives: Design an enterprise automation platform and programme
Prove governance, resilience and value with evidence
Defend the design to a review board
